## The project
A **Python CLI for NCLEX-PN remediation**: reads your `seed/missed.json` (your missed-question log: topic, client need, why you missed it), generates a 7-day study plan targeting your gaps, prints it to stdout. Plain JSON storage so you can edit it on your phone. Canadian RPN scope. Built to help you prep.

## Rules in force

**Constraints:**
- Python standard library only, local, no network (rule)
- Never reproduce paid qbank text—topic tags and your own notes only (rule)
- Every plan template must use PN scope of practice language: reinforce, monitor, report, follow the care plan. No RN-level wording like "independently assess and initiate treatment" (rule)
- Personal use only. Don't package it, push it to GitHub, or distribute it (rule)

**Parked:**
- No gamification (streaks, badges, leaderboards) for now—it's a distraction (rule)

## What's still owed

**rule — OPEN obligation:** Before you show this to your study group, someone with a nursing background needs to review every plan template for scope-of-practice wording. **That review has not happened yet.** Until it does, this blocks any study-group sharing.

Also: You decided not to show it to the study group this week (rule), so the focus right now is just keep improving it.
